none: PAS SUSS-68A080: copper alloy Roman coin
contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

An extremely worn and corroded copper-alloy contemporary or 'barbarous' copy of a Roman radiate nummus. Probably of the Gallic Empire, c. 3rd century AD. Both surfaces are too distorted and worn to identify; however, it is possible to discern traces of the obverse legend, which be indicate that this is a coin of Tetricus. Obverse: traces of radiate head facing right. Obverse legend: (TET?)[...];…
